details: Sumud announced a separate public Helsinki demonstration with Finnish-state demands, but its exact event page redirected and no independently verified execution/turnout was found. Do not conflate it with the separate Aalto sit-in counted at 175.
Search snippet points to a Rauhanpuolustajat archive URL whose opened body contains 2018 content, not 2024 evidence. Current occurrence, target, and turnout remain unresolved.
One republished organizer report describes the gathering but does not give a count or explicit Finnish state demand; independent local corroboration not found in this search pass.

Finnish/English queries and Yle/organizer/Amnesty sources dominate; local and regional sources, sector searches, and exact city follow-through remain incomplete. This is not exhaustive and does not establish zero events.
